:::{#exm-infinite-sum}
#### A finite and an infinite sum

- For $a_i = 1/2^i$, the partial sums $s_n = 1 - 1/2^n$ (@exm-partial-sum)
  converge to $1$, because $1/2^n \to 0$.
  So $\sum_{i=1}^{\infty} 1/2^i = 1$.
- For $a_i = 1$, the partial sums are $s_n = n$,
  which diverge to $\infty$.
  So $\sum_{i=1}^{\infty} 1 = \infty$.

:::
